tasks.prompt: Compute NDVI for these Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9 samples and explain why the supplied DN-ratio shortcut is wrong even though the map looks reasonable.
tasks.inputs: Sensor-labelled red/NIR bands in original offset DN encoding and independently decoded surface-reflectance equivalents, common grids and QA masks. Include nodata, a valid zero NDVI pixel, equal-zero denominator, unsigned subtraction risk and control NDVI values within [-1, 1].
acceptance: Map Sentinel-2 B08/B04 and Landsat 8/9 SR_B5/SR_B4, apply source calibration exactly once, then use (NIR - red) / (NIR + red).
Cast before arithmetic, propagate both masks, keep valid zero and mark zero-denominator/nonfinite results nodata without silently clipping.
Compare control values to independent physical-reflectance calculations; explain that additive offsets do not cancel in the ratio.
Run python -m terraproof check ndvi.tif --expect index; expected_checks applies to the correctly decoded, masked output with declared nodata.
Explain that an incorrect DN-ratio can still pass the nominal range check.
tasks.pitfall: An unscaled DN ratio remains within the nominal range and is falsely accepted as calibrated NDVI.

tasks.prompt: Map open-water contrast near an urban shoreline using both McFeeters NDWI and MNDWI. Explain which formula each map uses instead of returning an ambiguously named NDWI layer.
tasks.inputs: Aligned physical SR green/NIR/SWIR1 bands for Sentinel-2 and Landsat 8/9, plus Sentinel-2 coarser native SWIR1 data and reference grid metadata. Include water, built-up land, shadows and a local reference sample whose known NDWI/MNDWI values differ; corrected inputs are nonnegative and nonzero-sum on valid controls.
acceptance: Use (green - NIR) / (green + NIR) for McFeeters NDWI and (green - SWIR1) / (green + SWIR1) for MNDWI; do not substitute the Gao moisture definition.
Map Sentinel-2 B03/B08/B11 and Landsat 8/9 SR_B3/SR_B5/SR_B6; align the full grid and explain the effective SWIR information resolution.
Verify both formulas on independent control pixels and masks, then choose any water threshold using the local reference sample rather than asserting a universal cutoff.
Run python -m terraproof check ndwi_mcfeeters.tif mndwi.tif --expect index; expected_checks applies to these same-grid, declared-nodata outputs.
State that rs.index_range cannot identify a wrong water-index definition.
tasks.pitfall: An NIR/SWIR moisture ratio is mislabeled McFeeters NDWI, or SWIR is paired with a shifted/finer array without documented alignment.

tasks.prompt: Produce pre/post NBR and dNBR plus EVI and SAVI from these reflectance samples. Do not clip valid formula results just to satisfy a generic index-range test.
tasks.inputs: Same-grid, masked, physical SR blue/red/NIR/SWIR2 bands with seasonal metadata for both dates and independent formula controls. Include a pre/post NBR pair whose unscaled dNBR exceeds 1, a finite EVI outside [-1, 1], a zero EVI denominator, and SAVI controls with L=0.5 and reflectances in [0, 1].
acceptance: Use NIR/SWIR2 NBR and prefire-minus-postfire dNBR with both-date mask intersection; match control signs and values and report seasonal confounding.
Use EVI gain 2.5, red coefficient 6, blue coefficient 7.5 and background constant 1; compute SAVI with L=0.5 on physical reflectance, not DN.
Preserve the finite out-of-nominal EVI/dNBR control results for review, mark zero denominators nodata and explain why dNBR can span [-2, 2] and EVI is not universally bounded by [-1, 1].
Run python -m terraproof check nbr_prefire.tif nbr_postfire.tif --expect index; expected_checks applies only to the two NBR outputs, not EVI or dNBR.
Do not claim automatic formula, burn-severity threshold or denominator-policy validation; independently compare all index controls within the fixture's stated floating tolerance.
tasks.pitfall: dNBR sign is reversed, NBR uses SWIR1, EVI/SAVI constants are mixed with DN units, or valid changes are clipped to pass a generic range test.
